subject: session date
fact: The events occur on Planting 16, 579.
source_quote: ### Date: Planting 16, 579

subject: session date
fact: The following day's events occur on Planting 17, 579.
source_quote: ### Date: Planting 17, 579

subject: session date
fact: The events occur on Planting 18, 579.
source_quote: ### Date: Planting 18, 579

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer insists that the group must go to the Prefect to inform him of what has happened.
source_quote: Calmer insists, “We must go to the Prefect and inform him of what has happened!”

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer returns to the Temple of St. Cuthbert to complete prayers before meeting Burne and Refus.
source_quote: For some reason, Calmer bows out and says he must return to the Temple to complete some prayers.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer asks the group if they will meet again tomorrow at the same time.
source_quote: Before he leaves, he asks, “Tomorrow at the same time?”

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia notices two sons carefully grooming the horses at Elder Kenter’s compound.
source_quote: Sequoia notices how two sons carefully groom the horses.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia laughs and agrees to let Spugnoir join the group.
source_quote: Sequoia laughs, “Somehow, you are very familiar.” He then pauses, “Sure.”

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia struggles to sleep thinking about Zephyr’s confusion and the teenagers squealing.
source_quote: Sequoia struggles to sleep as he thinks about Zephyr looking confused and the two teenagers squealing.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia agrees with Calmer that the group should inform the Prefect.
source_quote: Sequoia, Zinia, and Zephyr agree.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia realizes the town has no secrets after telling Jaroo who they spoke to.
source_quote: Zinia realizes this town has no secrets, and he tells the truth.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia heads to the door after Ostler mentions the Druid.
source_quote: Zinia gets the point and gets up, heading to the door.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia grabs the loaded dice from the tipped table and declares them proof.
source_quote: Zinia moves quickly and grabs the dice. As he picks them up, he realizes they are loaded—“The proof I needed!”

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia snarls and tells Jira and Marek to go away.
source_quote: Zinia snarls and tells them to go away.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is intrigued by Prefect Terjon wanting to keep the painted rock.
source_quote: Zephyr is intrigued by Terjon wanting to hold onto a worthless rock.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr smiles sweetly and asks Prefect Terjon why he wants to keep the worthless rock.
source_quote: He smiles sweetly, “If this rock is so worthless, why keep it?”

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr receives the painted rock from Prefect Terjon after he tosses it.
source_quote: Terjon winces... and then he tosses the rock to Zephyr.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr hands the painted rock to Burne and Refus at the Inn.
source_quote: Zephyr hands over the rock.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr suggests they need someone to help find a monster in the Gnarley forest.
source_quote: Zephyr smiles, “There is a monster in the Gnarley forest, and we will need someone to help us find it.”

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr falls on the table to create a distraction during his failed pickpocket attempt.
source_quote: So he falls on the table that Furnok is sitting on, causing the table to tip over.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr sneaks up on the two cloaked figures at midnight with his sword drawn.
source_quote: Zephyr plans to sneak up on the spies... Zephyr quickly advances on them, his sword in his right hand...

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr puts the blade to the throat of the smaller spy and forces the teenagers to be quiet.
source_quote: Zephyr uses all his tiefling fierceness to force the two squealing teenagers to be quiet.

subject: Prefect Terjon
fact: Prefect Terjon examines the painted rock and dismisses it as worthless.
source_quote: The Prefect examines the stone... finally says in disgust, “You bring me a painted rock... all I have is your word.”

subject: Prefect Terjon
fact: Prefect Terjon says he would like to keep the painted rock.
source_quote: Zinia asks for the rock, but Terjon surprisingly says, “I would like to keep this worthless rock.”

subject: Prefect Terjon
fact: Prefect Terjon mutters that the rock is worthless as he tosses it to Zephyr.
source_quote: Terjon mutters as it flies through the air, “You’re right. It is worthless.”

subject: Burne
fact: Burne mutters in disbelief upon seeing the painted rock.
source_quote: Two scrutinize the rock, and finally, Burne mutters, “This is it?”

subject: Burne
fact: Burne says they must keep the investigation quiet.
source_quote: Burne stretches and says, “And keep this quiet. We don’t want to tell anyone.”

subject: Refus
fact: Refus whispers that he suspects a saboteur copied the keep’s blueprints.
source_quote: Rufus whispers, “We may have a job for you... I suspect that someone has copied our blueprints... I am convinced it is one of the workers in the encampments.”

subject: Refus
fact: Refus asks the group to find the thief who copied the blueprints.
source_quote: You must go and find the thief.

subject: Ostler
fact: Ostler tells the group that adventurers must stay at least three nights at the Inn.
source_quote: Ostler grabs him by the arm, “So that you know; adventurers have a minimum three-night stay at the Inn.”

subject: Ostler
fact: Ostler offers free rooms for three nights if the group proves Furnoc steals from guests.
source_quote: he explains that his job offer is to prove that Furnoc is a crook who steals from the Inn’s guests. To sweeten the pot, he offers free rooms for three nights.

subject: Ostler
fact: Ostler greets the trio at the door after they return from visiting Jaroo.
source_quote: From there, the trio heads to the Inn of the Welcome Wench, where Ostler, obviously informed of the visit to Jaroo and the blessing, greets the trio at the door.

subject: Jaroo
fact: Jaroo admonishes the group to go deeper into the moathouse for more evidence.
source_quote: Like all the other town leaders, he is disappointed when Jaroo is presented with the stone and confession. “You must go deeper into the moathouse and find more evidence,” he admonishes.

subject: Jaroo
fact: Jaroo asks the group who else they have spoken to.
source_quote: Jaroo shouts, “Who else have you spoken to?”

subject: Jaroo
fact: Jaroo offers the group the blessing of Beory and a healing potion.
source_quote: Jaroo is pleased and offers them the blessing of Beory and a healing potion.

subject: Elder Kenter
fact: Elder Kenter welcomes the trio to his compound and invites them to sit.
source_quote: Standing in the middle of the room is an older man... “My name is Kenter... Please sit.”

subject: Elder Kenter
fact: Elder Kenter says Hawthorne followed the group and saw them visit Jaroo, Terjon, Burne, and Refus.
source_quote: My second son, Hawthorne, saw you come from the moathouse. He followed you and saw you visited Jaroo, Terjon, Burne, and Refus.

subject: Elder Kenter
fact: Elder Kenter names the council members: Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, Ostler, and Captain Zeb Fletcher.
source_quote: The council members are Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, and Ostler, whom you have already met, as well as Captain Zeb Fletcher, father of Elmo and Mytch the Miller.

subject: Elder Kenter
fact: Elder Kenter says Burne and Rufus have shown remarkable leadership in responding to the bandit threat.
source_quote: Burne and Rufus have shown remarkable leadership and strategic acumen. Their efforts in organizing defenses and training our militia have been crucial in our response to the bandit threat.

subject: Elder Kenter
fact: Elder Kenter expects the group to come to him first going forward.
source_quote: Therefore, going forward, I expect you all to come here first.

subject: Elder Kenter
fact: Elder Kenter toasts with wine, saying, “The Blessings of Beory.”
source_quote: When the Elder gets his glass, he coughs and toasts, “The Blessings of Beory.”

subject: Elmo
fact: Elmo shouts at Furnok to leave or he’ll call the Captain.
source_quote: A burly, muscular man sitting at another table shouts, “Get out of here, Furnok, or I’ll have to call the Captain, and he won’t be as kindly as Ostler is.”

subject: Elmo
fact: Elmo identifies himself as an adventurer and a ranger.
source_quote: They quickly learn that Elmo is an adventurer and a ranger by profession.

subject: Elmo
fact: Elmo says he is the person to help find the monster in the Gnarley forest.
source_quote: Elmo mutters, “I am your person!”

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir offers to join the group and split treasures if he gets first crack at arcane scrolls.
source_quote: I am offering to split the treasures as long as I get the first crack at any arcane scrolls we find.

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir says he knows the location of a lost wizard laboratory under Emiry Meadows.
source_quote: I know the location of a lost wizard laboratory under Emiry Meadows.

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir asks to join the group to complete their quartet.
source_quote: I would like to go adventuring with you and complete your quartet. If you would have me?

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir agrees to meet the group the next day.
source_quote: “Tomorrow then, as it is quite late!”

subject: Mickey
fact: Mickey whispers to the group that he saw cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at midnight.
source_quote: My name’s Mickey... I've seen a couple of cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at around midnight.

subject: Mickey
fact: Mickey says he is the son of Virgil Tamen, the Braumeister.
source_quote: I am the son of Virgil Tamen, the Braumeister.

subject: Mickey
fact: Mickey asks the group to investigate the cloaked people because he is worried about rumors of the temple being alive.
source_quote: I'm worried, I mean, I, I, you know, I, the rumors around the village is going that the temple isn't as dead as everybody thought. And so maybe, those are, uh, spies.

subject: Jira
fact: Jira introduces herself as one of the two cloaked teenagers spotted at midnight.
source_quote: The girl introduces herself as Jira...

subject: Jira
fact: Jira pleads with Zinia to help her and Marek talk to their parents.
source_quote: Jira pleads with Zinia to help them and talk to their parents — “You’re heroes, and they’ll listen!”

subject: Marek
fact: Marek introduces himself as one of the two cloaked teenagers spotted at midnight.
source_quote: ...and the boy as Marek.

subject: Furnok
fact: Furnok rejects the accusations of stealing from guests.
source_quote: Ostler confronts Furnok, who rejects the accusations.

subject: Valsenora
fact: Valsenora brings treats to the table for the trio at Elder Kenter’s compound.
source_quote: They all nod and leave politely after sampling some of the treats that Kenter’s wife, Valsenora, brings to the table.

subject: Hawthorne
fact: Hawthorne followed the group and observed their visits to town leaders.
source_quote: My second son, Hawthorne, saw you come from the moathouse. He followed you and saw you visited Jaroo, Terjon, Burne, and Refus.

subject: Captain Zeb Fletcher
fact: Captain Zeb Fletcher is a member of the village council and father of Elmo and Mytch the Miller.
source_quote: The council members are Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, and Ostler, whom you have already met, as well as Captain Zeb Fletcher, father of Elmo and Mytch the Miller.

subject: Airgid
fact: Airgid the silver dragon says her home is near the Lotrimil mountains.
source_quote: The dragon explains that its home is near the Lotrimil mountains.

subject: Airgid
fact: Airgid the silver dragon shouts “HOME!” as she spots her home.
source_quote: the dragon suddenly shouts, “HOME!”

subject: Airgid
fact: Airgid the silver dragon says her mommy will reward the group.
source_quote: As she leaves, she shouts, “Don’t worry, my mommy will reward you! I KNOW SHE WILL! THANK YOU!”

subject: The Duke
fact: The Duke sets up camp at the moathouse.
source_quote: The Duke sets up camp.

subject: The Duke
fact: The Duke says he hopes to see the group again.
source_quote: “I hope I see you again.”

subject: Hommlett
fact: The group decides to return to Hommlett after the bandit confession.
source_quote: the group decides to return to Hommlett.

subject: The Tower
fact: The Tower is visible in the distance as the group approaches Hommlett.
source_quote: A few hours later, the heroes can see “The Tower” in the distance...

subject: Temple of St. Cuthbert
fact: Calmer explains the discovery to Prefect Terjon inside the Temple of St. Cuthbert.
source_quote: Once inside the temple of St. Cuthbert, Calmer excitedly explains to Prefect Terjon the proof...

subject: Inn of the Welcome Wench
fact: Burne and Refus are drinking at the Inn of the Welcome Wench.
source_quote: At the Inn, in the main hall, Burne and Refus are sitting at the table, drinking.

subject: Inn of the Welcome Wench
fact: Ostler greets the group at the door of the Inn of the Welcome Wench after they return from visiting Jaroo.
source_quote: From there, the trio heads to the Inn of the Welcome Wench, where Ostler... greets the trio at the door.

subject: Inn of the Welcome Wench
fact: Ostler ushers the group into the kitchen to discuss Furnok’s theft.
source_quote: he ushers them into the kitchen, explaining that his job offer is to prove that Furnoc is a crook who steals from the Inn’s guests.

subject: Elder Kenter’s compound
fact: The group visits the residence of Elder Kenter, which has an eight-foot-high stone wall and a heavy gate.
source_quote: Zinia leads them to a place with an eight-foot-high stone wall and a heavy gate. It is the residence of some well-to-do folk and easily defensible in times of trouble.

subject: Elder Kenter’s compound
fact: Elder Kenter’s compound houses five families and servants.
source_quote: Zinia quickly discovers that the compound has five families: the village elder and his wife, the four sons and their wives... There are also some servants here as well.

subject: Elder Kenter’s compound
fact: Elder Kenter’s compound has a large seating area with chairs, a divan, rugs, and a small table.
source_quote: Past the central doorway, there is a large seating area with several comfortable chairs, a divan, several colorful rugs, and a small table.

subject: Gnarley forest
fact: Zephyr mentions a monster in the Gnarley forest that needs to be found.
source_quote: Zephyr smiles, “There is a monster in the Gnarley forest, and we will need someone to help us find it.”

subject: Moathouse
fact: The group is advised to go deeper into the moathouse for more evidence.
source_quote: You must go deeper into the moathouse and find more evidence

subject: Moathouse
fact: The group returns to the moathouse and enters the courtyard.
source_quote: they are once again at the moathouse... Inside the courtyard, Calmer asks...

subject: Moathouse
fact: The group finds a collapsed tower with a faint gleam of coins inside.
source_quote: Zinia points to the tower that they ignored last time... Looking at the floor, Sequoia and Zephyr notice a faint gleam of coins.

subject: Moathouse
fact: The group enters the great hall and finds a passageway with two south doors and one north door.
source_quote: Sequoia crosses the courtyard, enters the great hall, and turns west into a passageway with two doors on the south and one to the north.

subject: Emiry Meadows
fact: Spugnoir knows the location of a lost wizard laboratory under Emiry Meadows.
source_quote: I know the location of a lost wizard laboratory under Emiry Meadows.

subject: Lotrimil mountains
fact: Airgid the dragon’s home is near the Lotrimil mountains.
source_quote: The dragon explains that its home is near the Lotrimil mountains.

subject: Kron Hills
fact: Ostler says the way to the Lotrimil mountains is west through the Kron Hills.
source_quote: Ostler explains that that’s to the west through the Kron Hills.

subject: Greenway Valley
fact: Ostler says the fastest route to the Lotrimil mountains is south into the Greenway Valley.
source_quote: The fastest way is to head south and turn north into the Greenway Valley.

subject: brewery
fact: Mickey reports seeing cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at midnight.
source_quote: I've seen a couple of cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at around midnight.

subject: ruined boathouse
fact: A farmer's daughter, Lysia, wants to explore the ruined boathouse.
source_quote: a farmer's daughter, Lysia, is itching to explore the ruined boathouse

subject: secret passage under the inn
fact: A patron mentions a secret passage below the inn leading to four lost chambers of a dead wizard.
source_quote: There is a secret passage below the inn that leads to an extensive set of four lost chambers of a long-dead wizard.

subject: painted rock
fact: The painted rock was found on the body of a bandit.
source_quote: Zephyr shares that the stone was found on the body of a bandit.

subject: painted rock
fact: Prefect Terjon claims the painted rock is worthless.
source_quote: You bring me a painted rock... this trinket and your words.

subject: painted rock
fact: Zephyr holds the painted rock after Terjon tosses it to him.
source_quote: Zephyr, the stone in his fist, exits the temple.

subject: blueprints
fact: The blueprints for the keep are missing and later return with traces of charcoal dust.
source_quote: I was recently examining the blueprints for the keep and found them missing... they had returned, but there were traces of charcoal dust on them.

subject: loaded dice
fact: Zinia finds the dice are loaded after grabbing them from the tipped table.
source_quote: Zinia moves quickly and grabs the dice. As he picks them up, he realizes they are loaded

subject: ivory box
fact: The group finds an ivory box about the size of a large book among the treasures in the collapsed tower.
source_quote: They find an ivory box about the size of a large book among the treasures.

subject: healing potion
fact: Jaroo gives the group a healing potion as a blessing.
source_quote: Jaroo is pleased and offers them the blessing of Beory and a healing potion.

subject: giant wolf spider
fact: A giant wolf spider attacks the group as they reach for coins in the collapsed tower.
source_quote: As they reach for the coin, a giant wolf spider attempts to turn them into its next meal.

subject: giant wolf spider
fact: The giant wolf spider is overmatched and defeated by the two rogues and the monk.
source_quote: But it is overmatched by the two rogues and the monk.

subject: Church of St. Cuthbert
fact: Marek’s father, Tomlyn, is a member of the Church of St. Cuthbert.
source_quote: Marek, whose father is Tomlyn, the tailor and a member of the Church of St. Cuthbert.

subject: old faith
fact: Jira’s father, Jakub, is a member of the old faith.
source_quote: Jakub is a member of the old faith and won’t let Jira be with Marek

subject: village council
fact: The village council consists of Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, Ostler, and Captain Zeb Fletcher.
source_quote: The council members are Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, and Ostler, whom you have already met, as well as Captain Zeb Fletcher, father of Elmo and Mytch the Miller.

subject: missing blueprints
fact: The blueprints for the keep were stolen and copied, and the thief is suspected to be a worker in the encampments.
source_quote: I suspect that someone has copied our blueprints... I am convinced it is one of the workers in the encampments.

subject: cloaked figures at midnight
fact: Cloaked figures are seen lurking behind the brewery at midnight, sparking rumors the temple is not dead.
source_quote: I've seen a couple of cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at around midnight... the rumors around the village is going that the temple isn't as dead as everybody thought.

subject: lost wizard laboratory
fact: Spugnoir knows of a lost wizard laboratory under Emiry Meadows and wants to join the group to find it.
source_quote: I know the location of a lost wizard laboratory under Emiry Meadows. I am offering to split the treasures as long as I get the first crack at any arcane scrolls we find.

subject: dragon's mother
fact: Airgid says her mommy will reward the group for returning her home.
source_quote: Don’t worry, my mommy will reward you! I KNOW SHE WILL! THANK YOU!

subject: Lysia’s exploration of the ruined boathouse
fact: Lysia, the farmer's daughter, wants to explore the ruined boathouse but needs equipment and competent companions.
source_quote: a farmer's daughter, Lysia, is itching to explore the ruined boathouse, but she needs some equipment and a few competent companions.
